app.name: FasalNetra
walk.welcome.title: Namaste {name}
walk.welcome.say: Namaste {name}. The satellite shows one part of your field getting weaker. Let us walk there and take photos.
walk.link_bad: This link has expired. We will send you a new one.
walk.goto.title: Walk to this part
walk.goto.say: Look for the red square on the map. Walk there. The phone vibrates when you arrive.
walk.gps.weak: GPS is weak. Showing the last known point.
walk.gps.denied: Location permission denied. Turn on Location in phone settings.
walk.photo.top.title: Photo of the leaf top
walk.photo.top.say: Show one leaf of a sick plant up close, from above. Then press the photo button.
walk.photo.under.title: Photo of the leaf underside
walk.photo.under.say: Now turn the same leaf over and photograph the underside. Whiteflies hide here.
walk.photo.blurry: Photo is blurry. Please take it again.
walk.photo.dark: Photo is too dark. Take it again in light.
walk.patch.title: Walk around the sick patch
walk.patch.say: Now walk once around the edge of the sick patch. Press stop when the round is done.
walk.done.title: Thank you
walk.done.say: Thank you. We have your photos. You will get a call in two minutes.
ev.low_spot: Patch is in a low spot, check for waterlogging
didi.title: Drone Didi
didi.empty: No jobs today. New jobs appear here.
didi.safety: Wear gloves and mask. Do not fly in strong wind.
dash.title: Live dashboard
walk.welcome.say2: Namaste {name}. The satellite shows one part of your field getting weaker. Open the camera, follow the red line and photograph the leaves.
walk.welcome.how: A red line appears on the camera. Walk along it. The voice tells you when to turn and when to stop.
walk.camera_denied: Camera permission denied. The photo button opens the gallery.
guide.arrived: Stop, you have arrived. Now photograph a leaf.
guide.follow_map: The blue dot on the small map is you
guide.loop: Keep walking the edge along the red line
result.title: Your field's result
result.sure: We are {pct} percent confident this is {cause}. Only {acres} acres need spraying.
result.unsure: We suspect {cause}, but we are not sure yet. Do not spray yet. We will also call you.
result.no_pesticide: This looks like {cause}. It needs no pesticide.
result.ask_didi: Do you want to connect to Drone Didi?
result.ask_didi_why: Didi will come and check the patch, and spray only there if needed.
result.no_ok: Okay. Call the Kisan Call Centre if you need help.
didi.verify_note: Confidence is low. Check the leaves first; spray only if confirmed.
didi.window_rule: Green = can fly (no rain, wind under 10 km/h)
didi.saved_vs: Only the sick patch instead of the whole field: {a} acres not sprayed (whole field would take {m} min)
walk.photo.auto: The photo is taken by itself once the leaf is sharp
walk.reason.patch_edge: Far end of the weak patch
walk.photo.hint.no_leaf: Bring a leaf in front of the camera
walk.where.away: You are {km} km from your field. Open the link at the field.
